english.title: Use on a road a vehicle fitted with an appliance / apparatus for lifting which was not properly secured
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), fitted with an appliance or apparatus designed for lifting having failed to ensure that the appliance or apparatus was properly secured in that **(..SPECIFY THE FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 108 of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
